question: What conduct should a practitioner with an even mind abandon through practice?
premises: Practice leads to an even mind
Village or conventional duties are specified
An injunction to abandon them is given
inference: Through practice, one with an even mind should abandon conventional village duties.
uncertainties: grāma-dharmañ may refer broadly to conventional social obligations
plain_english: Through practice, becoming even-minded, one should abandon the duties of village life.
